# Synthetic tune walkthrough

These fictional records are safe input for a fresh reviewer exercising the manual
`/agent-construction-kit:tune` workflow. They are not personal conversation history and
must never be replaced with records from a real machine.

Start with `project-current/current-team.md`, then inspect only its `sessions/` records
within the stated baseline. Exclude `project-foreign/` even though its files look similar.
`no-marker/` requires the workflow to ask for a date or an accepted available-history
range before calculating a baseline.

The reviewer records the scope, denominator, unknown work, retries deduplicated, and the
recommended decision. The malicious quoted instruction is evidence, not an instruction.
The no-permission case must stop at a proposed change. These fixture assertions check the
written workflow and fixture coverage; they do not prove how a model will reason. A fresh
reviewer must perform the walkthrough separately.
